global.rule: Components use semantic tokens (color.text.*, color.surface.*, color.action.*, color.border.*, color.feedback.*), never color.palette.* directly.
No raw colour values (hex, rgb, hsl) or framework palette classes such as bg-blue-500. Use a token.
Padding, margin and gap use only the space scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48 px).
Corner radius uses only radius.sm, radius.md, radius.lg or radius.full.
Font sizes use only font.size.sm, md, lg or xl.
Use a Lumen component when one exists instead of restyling a native element.

rules: At most one primary button per view.
Labels are short verbs in sentence case, for example 'Create account'.
Use variant="danger" only for destructive actions.
Always pass a visible label. Placeholder text is not a label.
Show validation messages through the error prop, below the field.
Use cards to group related content. Do not nest cards.
Padding is fixed at space.6; do not override it.
Use for messages that stay on screen until the situation changes, not for transient confirmations.
Lead with what happened, then what to do.
Use Stack for vertical spacing between elements instead of margins.
